tools.name: save_ride
tools.description: Upsert one of the caller's rides as domain records (ride request plus its driver, vehicle, quote, assignment, trip and trip status event). Idempotent: ids are derived from the client ride, so replaying the same ride changes nothing.
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO riders (id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:__user_id, :__now, :__now)

INSERT INTO drivers (rider_id, id, display_name, rating, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :__user_id, :driver_id, :driver_name, :driver_rating, 'active', :__now, :__now WHERE :driver_id IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (rider_id, id) DO UPDATE SET display_name = excluded.display_name, rating = COALESCE(excluded.rating, drivers.rating), updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO vehicles (rider_id, id, driver_id, plate, vehicle_class, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :__user_id, :vehicle_id, :driver_id, :vehicle_plate, :vehicle_class, :__now, :__now WHERE :vehicle_id IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (rider_id, id) DO UPDATE SET driver_id = excluded.driver_id, vehicle_class = COALESCE(excluded.vehicle_class, vehicles.vehicle_class), updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO ride_requests (rider_id, id, booking_type, status, pickup_label, pickup_lat, pickup_lng, dropoff_label, dropoff_lat, dropoff_lng, recurring_days, pickup_time, scheduled_for, vehicle_class, requested_at, client_record, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:__user_id, :request_id, :booking_type, :request_status, :pickup_label, :pickup_lat, :pickup_lng, :dropoff_label, :dropoff_lat, :dropoff_lng, :recurring_days, :pickup_time, :scheduled_for, :vehicle_class, :requested_at, :client_record, :created_at, :__now) ON CONFLICT (rider_id, id) DO UPDATE SET booking_type = excluded.booking_type, status = excluded.status, pickup_label = excluded.pickup_label, pickup_lat = excluded.pickup_lat, pickup_lng = excluded.pickup_lng, dropoff_label = excluded.dropoff_label, dropoff_lat = excluded.dropoff_lat, dropoff_lng = excluded.dropoff_lng, recurring_days = excluded.recurring_days, pickup_time = excluded.pickup_time, scheduled_for = excluded.scheduled_for, vehicle_class = excluded.vehicle_class, requested_at = excluded.requested_at, client_record = excluded.client_record, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO quotes (rider_id, id, request_id, vehicle_class, fare_cents, eta_minutes, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :__user_id, :quote_id, :request_id, :vehicle_class, :fare_cents, :eta_minutes, 'accepted', :__now, :__now WHERE :quote_id IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (rider_id, id) DO UPDATE SET vehicle_class = excluded.vehicle_class, fare_cents = excluded.fare_cents, eta_minutes = excluded.eta_minutes, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO assignments (rider_id, id, request_id, driver_id, vehicle_id, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :__user_id, :assignment_id, :request_id, :driver_id, :vehicle_id, 'accepted', :__now, :__now WHERE :assignment_id IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (rider_id, id) DO UPDATE SET driver_id = excluded.driver_id, vehicle_id = excluded.vehicle_id, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO trips (rider_id, id, request_id, assignment_id, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :__user_id, :trip_id, :request_id, :assignment_id, :trip_status, :__now, :__now WHERE :trip_id IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (rider_id, id) DO UPDATE SET assignment_id = excluded.assignment_id, status = excluded.status, updated_at = excluded.updated_at
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO trip_events (rider_id, id, trip_id, type, status, at) SELECT :__user_id, :trip_event_id, :trip_id, 'status', :trip_status, :__now WHERE :trip_event_id IS NOT NULL

tools.name: cancel_ride
tools.description: Cancel one of the caller's ride requests and any unfinished trip for it
statements: UPDATE ride_requests SET status = 'cancelled', updated_at = :__now WHERE rider_id = :__user_id AND id = :request_id
UPDATE trips SET status = 'cancelled', updated_at = :__now WHERE rider_id = :__user_id AND request_id = :request_id AND status NOT IN ('completed', 'cancelled')

tools.name: list_ride_requests
tools.description: List the caller's ride requests, newest first
tools.sql: SELECT id, booking_type, status, pickup_label, dropoff_label, recurring_days, pickup_time, scheduled_for, vehicle_class, created_at, updated_at FROM ride_requests WHERE rider_id = :__user_id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT :limit
